name: Johaan's Special Drink
summary: At Brill, Apothecary Johaan offers a drink with a deadly purpose. Disguised as a common refreshment, it tests the Royal Apothecary Society’s developing plague.

sections.title: A Toxic Brew
sections.body: In Brill, Apothecary Johaan prepares a brew from venomous components and local reagents. Though it looks like a tavern drink, the mixture is made to test how virulent the plague is against living beings. Johaan hands it over as if to quench a captive’s thirst. The work serves the Forsaken apothecaries’ effort to create a weapon potent enough to fulfill Sylvanas Windrunner’s designs for Azeroth.

sections.title: The Cellar Trial
sections.body: Beneath the Gallows' End Tavern, the Deathguard keeps stray intruders in a cellar holding cell. A captured dwarven mountaineer, chained there, eagerly drinks what he mistakes for crude ale. The brew kills him at once, showing the Royal Apothecary Society that its latest strain can swiftly extinguish living victims.

faq.answer: Apothecary Johaan prepares a deadly drink in Brill to test the Forsaken’s developing plague against living beings.

faq.q: Who is the drink given to?
aliases: who do i give the drink to
faq.answer: The drink is taken to the cellar beneath the Gallows' End Tavern in Brill and given to a captured mountaineer held by the local Deathguard.

faq.q: What happens when someone drinks it?
faq.answer: The prisoner drinks the brew, expecting harsh ale, and dies at once.

faq.q: Why does Apothecary Johaan make this drink?
faq.answer: Apothecary Johaan makes the drink to test the Royal Apothecary Society’s new plague. He gives it to a captured dwarf to see how effectively it kills mortal life.

angles.text: As Forsaken, you help the Royal Apothecary Society and advance Lady Sylvanas’s designs against the living.
As a dwarf, you face the danger of being captured by the Deathguard near Tirisfal Glades and used as a test subject.
